code.pseudocode: Positive covariance: both tend to be above their means together, or below together.
Negative covariance: when one is above its mean, the other tends to be below.

steps.label: Negative: one up, the other down

code.pseudocode: Covariance near zero: no consistent straight-line trend.
Multiply each point's deviations from the two means, then average the products.
Multiplying x by 10 multiplies the covariance by 10 but leaves the correlation unchanged.
correlation = covariance / (standard deviation of x * standard deviation of y)
